prompt.text:
Call the Workflow tool with this script, then answer `launched` and nothing else:

```js
export const meta = { name: 'scan-fix-verify', description: 'Read, print and write small files', phases: [
  { title: 'Scan', detail: 'read a.txt and b.txt' },
  { title: 'Fix', detail: 'eighteen agents print the files' },
  { title: 'Verify', detail: 'write d.txt' },
] }
phase('Scan')
const scanned = await parallel([
  () => agent('Read a.txt and answer with its first line only.', { label: 'read a', model: 'haiku', effort: 'low' }),
  () => agent('Read b.txt and answer with its first line only.', { label: 'read b', model: 'haiku', effort: 'low' }),
])
log('scanned ' + scanned.length + ' files')
phase('Fix')
const names = ['a.txt', 'b.txt', 'c.txt']
const printed = await parallel(Array.from({ length: 18 }, (_, i) => () => agent('Run `cat ' + names[i % 3] + '` with Bash and answer with its output only.', { label: 'cat ' + (i + 1), model: 'haiku', effort: 'low' })))
log('printed ' + printed.filter(Boolean).length + ' files')
phase('Verify')
const wrote = await agent('Run `echo delta > d.txt` with Bash, then answer `done` only.', { label: 'write d', model: 'haiku', effort: 'low' })
log('verified')
return [scanned.join(', '), wrote].join('; ')
```
